SQL_STMT_U.val:
SELECT incoming_delivery.id, incoming_delivery.slip_date, incoming_delivery.payee_id, billto.name AS bill_to_name, incoming_delivery.supplier_id, delivery.name AS delivery_to_name, incoming_delivery.reduced_purachse_amount, incoming_delivery.reduced_return_amount, incoming_delivery.reduced_discount_amount, incoming_delivery.reduced_tax, incoming_delivery.standard_purchase_amount, incoming_delivery.standard_discount_amount, incoming_delivery.standard_return_amount, incoming_delivery.standard_tax, summary.FirstSlipNo, summary.LastSlipNo,
LAG(incoming_delivery.id) OVER ( ORDER BY incoming_delivery.slip_date DESC, incoming_delivery.id DESC ) AS PrevSlipNo,
LEAD(incoming_delivery.id) OVER ( ORDER BY incoming_delivery.slip_date DESC, incoming_delivery.id DESC ) AS NextSlipNo
FROM incoming_delivery
LEFT JOIN supplier AS delivery ON incoming_delivery.supplier_id = delivery.id
LEFT JOIN supplier AS billto ON incoming_delivery.payee_id = billto.id
CROSS JOIN ( SELECT MIN(i.id) AS FirstSlipNo, MAX(i.id) AS LastSlipNo FROM incoming_delivery i WHERE i.supplier_id BETWEEN :1 AND :2 AND i.slip_date BETWEEN ':3' AND ':4' AND i.id BETWEEN :7 AND :8 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM incoming_delivery_detail d WHERE d.incoming_delivery_id = i.id AND d.product_cd BETWEEN :5 AND :6 ) ) AS summary
WHERE incoming_delivery.supplier_id BETWEEN :1 AND :2 AND incoming_delivery.slip_date BETWEEN ':3' AND ':4' AND incoming_delivery.id BETWEEN :7 AND :8 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM incoming_delivery_detail d WHERE d.incoming_delivery_id = incoming_delivery.id AND d.product_cd BETWEEN :5 AND :6 )
ORDER BY incoming_delivery.slip_date DESC, incoming_delivery.id DESC;

SELECT incoming_delivery_detail.slip_type, incoming_delivery_detail.product_cd, product.name AS product_name, incoming_delivery_detail.specification, incoming_delivery_detail.quantity, unit.name AS unit_name, incoming_delivery_detail.unit_price, incoming_delivery_detail.amount, incoming_delivery_detail.remark FROM incoming_delivery_detail LEFT JOIN incoming_delivery ON incoming_delivery_detail.incoming_delivery_id = incoming_delivery.id LEFT JOIN product ON incoming_delivery_detail.product_cd = product.product_cd LEFT JOIN unit ON incoming_delivery_detail.unit_id = unit.id WHERE incoming_delivery_detail.incoming_delivery_id = ':1';
